scheme_name: Economic Help To Sahariya Tribal Girl Students (Class 11 And 12)
other_conditions: The student must belong to the Saharia tribe of Baran district, Rajasthan
She must be studying regularly in a government school in classes 11th or 12th
The student's mother/father/guardian must not be an income taxpayer
She must not be residing in government residential schools or ashram hostels
She must possess a Vaidya Bhamashah card and Aadhaar
She must be a native of Rajasthan
benefits_summary: Students receive ₹3,500 total, paid as ₹350 per month for 10 months.
